config.text: Channel: WhatsApp (mobile chat). Reply guidance: keep messages short — one or two sentences for casual exchanges, one short paragraph max for substantive answers. WhatsApp renders a tiny subset of formatting (*bold*, _italic_, ~strike~, ```mono```) but no bullet lists, no headings, and no tables — prefer flowing prose. If you must enumerate, write a short inline list ("X, Y, and Z"). Long-form research belongs in an attached PDF, not in the message body.
